archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Traditional Indian Luxury
design_philosophy: A refined, trustworthy, and premium aesthetic. Avoiding kitschy 'magic' tropes. Emphasizing heritage, calm, and authority using soft warm tones, editorial serif typography, and generous negative space.

rules.contrast: Ensure text over images uses text-shadow or a solid gradient overlay. Never use pure #000000; use the Charcoal Mud (#2D2825).
rules.gradients: No vibrant digital gradients. Only use transparent-to-solid color gradients for overlays to blend images into the background.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use bento-style asymmetrical grids for Services and Rudraksha. Never perfectly symmetric 3-column Bootstrap layouts.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for a softer, organic feel.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(45,40,37,0.06)] for a soft, tactile elevation.

pages_and_sections.name: Navigation
pages_and_sections.rules: Sticky top bar. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF8F5]/80 with border-b border-[#E5DCD3]. Visible links on desktop, hamburger on mobile. CTA button 'Book Consultation' in Primary Terracotta.

pages_and_sections.name: Hero Section
pages_and_sections.rules: Editorial layout. Use the warm pattern texture as a subtle background. Left-aligned heavy Serif H1 (e.g., 'Discover Your Cosmic Blueprint'). Warm gradient overlay so text is highly readable. Right side can feature the Astrologer portrait or Temple imagery.

pages_and_sections.name: About the Astrologer
pages_and_sections.rules: Asymmetrical layout. Astrologer portrait slightly offset, overlapping a colored block (Secondary). List Education, Experience, and Specialties using refined typography and generous spacing.

pages_and_sections.name: Services & Booking
pages_and_sections.rules: Cards for 'Kundli Reading' and 'Marriage Match'. Implement a seamless Booking Form (Shadcn Calendar + Select). Include Razorpay integration CTA ('Pay & Book'). Use organic card shapes.

pages_and_sections.name: Rudraksha Info
pages_and_sections.rules: Gallery/Grid layout showcasing different beads (use Wood Bead Rosary image). Large high-quality images with overlapping text cards describing benefits.

pages_and_sections.name: Testimonials
pages_and_sections.rules: An elegant Marquee (using react-fast-marquee). High contrast: pale background with crisp dark cards. Include video thumbnail placeholders and text quotes.

pages_and_sections.name: Contact & Footer
pages_and_sections.rules: Massive py-32 footer. Deep dark contrast here (bg-[#2D2825] text-[#FAF8F5]). Massive typography for 'Connect with us'. Clear WhatsApp CTA (7499778268) and simple contact form.

components.buttons: Rounded-full for main CTAs (pill shape). Solid background for primary, 1px solid border for secondary.
components.inputs: Shadcn Inputs with custom border-[#E5DCD3] and focus:ring-[#BC472A]. Rounded-xl.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, soft hover lift (-translate-y-1) with ambient shadow.

image_urls.description: Portrait of Indian woman with traditional adornment. Use for the Astrologer About section.
Subtle warm Indian floral pattern. Use as a low-opacity background texture.
Wooden bead rosary close up. Use for the Rudraksha section.
Indian temple at sunset. Use if an architectural background is preferred for a section.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke width to 1.5 for a premium, delicate look.

testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='booking-submit-button', data-testid='whatsapp-contact-link', data-testid='service-card-kundli'.
instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use placeholder text or dummy image URLs. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing section structures (Hero, About, Grid). Only use Shadcn for complex interactives (Forms, Calendars, Selects).
Strictly adhere to the HSL CSS variables provided to ensure the Terracotta and Sand palette works properly with Shadcn components.
Inject Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' in index.html or layout wrapper.
Ensure the WhatsApp link dynamically formats to: https://wa.me/917499778268
Mock the Razorpay integration flow if backend is not available, but UI should simulate a real payment step.
